race.description: Tab Federal Road To The Chest Hcp
race.comment: BENGAL (7) has been around the mark without winning this campaign, placing at Hawkesbury last start after a solid Class 3 fourth at Randwick when held up. The weight relief and recent trial win at Canberra add to his case. SIR FRANKLIN (4) has been sound in BM72 company at Warwick Farm and Rosehill, and his 1300m record gives him a genuine minor-winning hope if he sharpens late. DEEPWATER ARTIST (8) resumes after five months off following a plain finish to his last campaign, when second last in a BM72 at Randwick. Proven fresh and fitted with the one 900m trial placing. STUPENDO (10) hampered at the start in a solid contest when fifth in a small field at Taree over 1000m. This trip suits and capable of better.
